post.excerpt: Welcome to the 23rd edition of Cloudflare’s Quarterly DDoS Threat Report. This report offers a comprehensive analysis of the evolving threat landscape of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks based on data from the Cloudflare network. In this edition, we focus on the third quarter of 2025.
post.title: Cloudflare's 2025 Q3 DDoS threat report -- including Aisuru, the apex of botnets
